resources.string: Tap the ring to talk. Long-press it for settings.
Downloads Termux, Termux:API, Termux:Widget and Termux:Boot from F-Droid and opens the installer for each. Android asks you to confirm every install.

Copies the one-line installer to the clipboard and opens Termux. Long-press the terminal → Paste → Enter. It takes a few minutes and ends with a ✓. This is the one step no app can do for you: Termux only accepts commands from other apps after this script enables it.
Written straight into Termux (phone/.env). Only the Telegram token is needed for Telegram; everything else is optional.
